metadataRaw.title: Stiff Neck Relief in SECONDS
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to quickly relieve a stiff neck.

If you're dealing with neck tightness, achiness, or pain when turning your head, this quick exercise may help.

It’s simple, requires no equipment, and can be done right at home — with relief possible in as little as 30 seconds.

Try it out and let us know how it works for you!
